title: What If Every Car Drove Itself? It Wouldn't Fix Most Crashes

scenes.text: What if every car on Earth drove itself? It still wouldn't stop most crashes.
Researchers at the IIHS studied more than 5,000 real crashes across the United States.
Then they asked which ones a perfect robot driver would have prevented.
Only about one third. Those are crashes from missed sightings, or a driver who was incapacitated.
The other two thirds came from bad judgment, like misreading another driver's next move, or the wrong speed for the road.
So a robot has to be a better guesser than a person, not just a better watcher.

description:
